authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
jurisdiction: Central Government / AICTE Scheme (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum lump-sum scholarship towards college fees and living costs

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (Orphan / Wards of Armed Forces / Parents Deceased due to COVID-19)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be an orphan, or a ward of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action, or whose parents died due to COVID-19.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Swanath Guidelines Clause 2.1 - Eligibility Categories
criteria.remediation: Upload valid certificate from competent authority proving orphan status, COVID bereavement, or defense martyr ward status.

criteria.label: Enrolled in 1st year of AICTE approved UG Technical Degree program
criteria.plain_description: Student must be admitted to 1st year degree course in an AICTE-approved technical institution.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Swanath Guidelines Clause 2.2 - Institutional Admission
criteria.remediation: Upload AICTE approved college admission letter.

criteria.label: Annual family income threshold (<= ₹8,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹8 Lakh per year.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Swanath Guidelines Clause 2.3 - Income Ceiling

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Student must have Aadhaar linked with their bank account.

application.office_name: AICTE Student Development Cell / College Student Welfare Cell
documents_to_carry: Orphan certificate / Parents death certificate / Armed Forces certificate
Admission letter for AICTE approved degree course
Aadhaar Card and NPCI-seeded Bank Account Passbook
process_steps: Register via One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Select scheme: AICTE - SWANATH SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (DEGREE)
Upload eligibility category proof and institutional fee details
College verification through NSP Head of Institution (HOI) login
Direct DBT grant of ₹50,000/yr disbursed directly into student's bank account
